messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's identity to match the person in the reference photo. Use the reference photo for facial identity, and make the body's skin tone consistent with the target person. Keep the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's identity to match the person in the reference photo. Use the reference photo for facial identity, and make the body's skin tone consistent with the target person. Keep the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on a rooftop, turning her body and raising one arm to touch her hair while posing.","camera":"A medium full-body shot at eye level that slowly pulls back to reveal more of the legs and feet.","clothing":"A white short dress with a floral print of purple, pink, and green flowers, plus light-colored flat shoes.","hair_color":"Deep red / maroon.","hairstyle":"Hair is pulled up into a high bun with loose strands framing the face.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, shown in profile and from behind.","scene":"An outdoor city rooftop at dusk, with tall buildings, construction cranes, and a wet reflective tiled floor."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's skin tone became noticeably lighter across the face, arms, and legs. The visible facial features also appear altered, with a lighter complexion and somewhat different facial proportions, though the red bun, floral dress, rooftop scene, pose, and camera movement remain largely the same.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's facial identity to match the reference photo and make the body skin tone consistent with the target, while preserving hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.
uncertain: The facial identity cannot be confidently confirmed as matching the reference photo because the character is mostly shown in profile and from behind.
unexpected_changes: The output frames appear slightly narrower/cropped compared with the source, with black bars visible on the sides in some frames.
